Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea…
So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God…
Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and…
They came to him, and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

translations.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
translations.bsb: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
